audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Level 2 to 'Skill' and Level 3 to Malphite while whys[1] and whys[2] on the same page say both are Wukong's, and it gave Level 6 to Wukong while whys[4] says 'Malphite's Unstoppable Force (R) at six flips the lane in his favor'.
audit.why: The mirror (malphite__wukong) already set the chart to Wukong / Wukong / Wukong / Malphite / Malphite / Malphite / Malphite. I am restating it rather than re-deriving; note it differs from the packet chart at rows 4 and 7, and the mirror is what mirror-fix.js will enforce.
audit.corrected: Levels 2 and 3 flipped to Wukong and Level 6 to Malphite as matched pairs on both layers, ratings following, and whys[3]/whys[6] nudged so the prose no longer says 'even' on rows the chart now awards to Malphite.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[1..6].why were template strings naming no spike.
audit.why: The real shape: you own 1-3 against an armour-less Malphite, level 4-5 is the pivot as Ground Slam's attack-speed cut bites, 6 is Unstoppable Force at 130s, and his first armour item both walls your burst and feeds his own damage.
audit.corrected: All six rewritten with the mechanic and the cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. Unstoppable Force was called 'a point-and-click knockup' in spikes[1].text and wants.foe[1]; and Ground Slam's most important property was never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text on R: 'Malphite launches himself to a location at high speed' — it is a location dash, not point-and-click, which is exactly the difference between a fight you can sidestep or body-block and one you cannot. And Ground Slam 'deals magic damage based on his Armor' on a flat 7s: every armour item he buys is also a damage item, which is why waiting him out gets worse rather than better.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text and wants.foe[1] fixed; the armour-scaling stated in breakdown.cooldowns and phases[3].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers and two placeholder bullets.
audit.why: Seismic Shard is a flat 8s and Ground Slam a flat 7s — neither gets shorter, so the trade windows are fixed and countable. R is 130s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

notes: Derived-flag misfire worth recording: the kit file flags BOTH Seismic Shard and Ground Slam with 'grounding — shuts off enemy dashes', but Riot's own descriptions say only move-speed steal (Q) and attack-speed reduction (E). Per the rule I trusted the description and wrote nothing about grounding — which matters here, because a page claiming Malphite grounds would tell a Wukong player his Nimbus Strike and clone dash are disabled in a lane where they are not. Someone should check whether the parser is tagging every slow/zone spell as grounding across the dataset. Also note the mirror's chart differs from the packet chart at rows 4 and 7; I followed the mirror. No Wukong cooldowns used — ownerKit was null in this brief.
